content.comment_body: I need assistance installing the [product_name] Web Editor. I keep encountering the error message: "Most probably the bundle JVM is not compatible with the current platform." I am using Windows 10 64-bit with the latest Java release, and [product_name] Soft Comfort runs without issues. Any help would be appreciated.
Which version of [product_name] Web Editor are you trying to install?
I am attempting to install version 1.1.

Consider trying the latest available version, V1.1.1. This version is included in the download package for [product_name] Soft Comfort V8.3 Service Pack 1. Refer to the installation instructions for [product_name] Soft Comfort V8.3 SP1.
The error still appears when I attempt to install [product_name] Web Editor.
You may want to submit a support request for further assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing compatibility errors when trying to install the [product_name] Web Editor on Windows 10 64-bit, even with the latest Java and a working installation of [product_name] Soft Comfort. Updating to the latest version has not resolved the JVM compatibility problem, suggesting ongoing compatibility challenges.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Web Editor to install seamlessly on Windows 10 with the latest Java, assuming the product should be compatible with modern Windows systems and current Java versions.
